content:
Maria: kicking off promotion for RC rc-search-v5.0.0. Plan: canary on internal traffic (10%), then public staged ramp with feature-flag gating. Target window in 45m.

Jake: Confirmed artifact sha: gcr.io/redwood/search:sha-deadbeef. DB migration: users.search_index schema v5 (adds token_count column, non-blocking). Backfill will run at low qps.

Priya: Ops note 124: add index build throttle. If backfill lag > 2000 rows/min we pause and notify.

Ryan-PM: PM wants rollout pause after canary for 15m for validation on relevance metrics.

Maria: Updated plan: 10% internal canary -> 15m hold -> 5% public -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Feature flag key: ff.search_v5. We will flip at each stage.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled by maria for rc-search-v5.0.0. Pipeline: unit tests -> integration smoke -> internal-canary -> public ramps.

deploy-bot: Internal canary started (10% internal). Health checks: 4/4.

Priya: quick smoke: relevance sanity set A pass, latency p95 +10ms but within SLO. Backfill lag 120 rows/min.

infra-bot: NOTE: nodepool-ssd-autoscaler will scale for index builds. Watch iops.

Maria: Requesting explicit +1 from jake and priya before moving to public.

Jake: +1. Im watching DB migration counters.

Priya: +1 :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Initiating public ramp: feature flag ff.search_v5 -> 5% for all users.

deploy-bot: Public 5% -> 25% (hold 4m).

Oncall: observing error spike at public 12: embeddings lookup timeouts up small but failure still < threshold.

Jake: I'm seeing increased lock contention on search_index table during large queries. Rolling back heavy aggregations temporarily.

Maria: Pause ramp. Switching to a narrower feature flag cohort (beta_users only) and throttling backfill to 50r/min.

deploy-bot: Ramp paused by automation due to manual hold. Flag changed: ff.search_v5 -> beta_users only.

Priya: After throttling backfill and disabling aggregations, contention reduced. Recommending slow resume: 5% -> 15% -> 40% with 6m holds.

Ryan-PM: PM approves slower ramp. Keep quiet window 20m after 100%.

Maria: rollback criteria reiterated: error rate > 2% for 3m OR search latency p95 increase >25% vs baseline for 5m. Manual rollback is oncall's call.

Oncall: Acknowledged. I have rollback steps in runbook and an abort hook set for index lag >5000 rows/min.

Maria: Rollback snippet in runbook for quick exec:

```
# rollback image
kubectl -n search set image deploy/search-service search=gcr.io/redwood/search:sha-c0ffee00
# revert feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://internal-admin/flags/ff.search_v5/revert
# lower backfill workers
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://internal-admin/backfill/throttle?rate=50
```

deploy-bot: Resuming public ramp to 15% now.

Priya: monitoring DB contention and iops, all trending down.

deploy-bot: public 40% -> 100% with configured holds. Promotion complete. Quiet window active for 20m.

Ryan-PM: Relevance metrics look stable on initial sweep. Good work.

Maria: Thanks team. Ill run post-promo checks at quiet window end and open postmortem if any regressions show up.

Oncall: Will post telemetry summary in this thread when quiet window ends.

Priya: added notes to runbook about throttles and aggregation rollback steps for future RCs.

Maria: closing promo channel once quiet window and telemetry sweep are green.
